svg.title: Toolbox
svg.desc: Toolbox. Computer vision: OpenCV, PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, YOLOX-S, PaddleOCR, PatchCore, NumPy. GenAI and NLP: OpenAI API, ChromaDB, FAISS, Sentence-Transformers, spaCy, NLTK, Gradio. Data and ML: pandas, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, Jupyter, MySQL, SQLite. Engineering: Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, Vite, Leaflet, GitHub Actions, pytest.
